thread:
sasha_pm: Stonebridge just escalated — seeing p99 inference timeouts on the dedicated pool for the embeddings route. CS reports retries and 503s. Need eng owners and an ETA. cc @mike_eng @jenna_sre

leo_oncall: can you paste logs or example req ids? is this Hosted or Dedicated?

sasha_pm: Dedicated. pool id: pool-stone-3. sample request id: 0a1b2c3d. CS timeline + Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/stonebridge/overview

jenna_sre: I saw a warning in the kernel-selector rollout logs at ~02:14 UTC. Could be related — selector changed kernel heuristics for short sequences.

mike_eng: I'll own the code-side investigation. I'll bisect the runtime change and prepare a patch. ETA ~2h if no surprises. @carlos_eng can you assist with runtime traces?

carlos_eng: on it. grabbing KV cache + shard logs now, will paste whatever I find.

alice_devex: pinging eng-reviews — can someone do a quick CR for mike's fix? small change.

mike_eng: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/789 — fixes batch-size calc under a seq_len edge-case, adds a regression test.

carlos_eng: quick log snippet: ``ERROR runtime.kv_cache: mismatch seq_len for shard 7`` repeating every ~250ms. correlates with timeout spikes.

jenna_sre: temp mitigation plan: shift Stonebridge traffic to fallback model variant (quantized-v2) + scale the dedicated pool up 2x. I'll apply traffic rule now and watch.

deploy-bot: Canary rule change applied to route stonebridge-embeds: split 90/10 -> 0/100 fallback; triggered at 2478451500.

incident-bot: INC-2026 created for Stonebridge P1 latency. Priority: P1. Oncall: leo_oncall.

leo_oncall: monitoring dashboard — p99 dropped after split but errors still present on retries. keeping an eye on error rate and tail latency.

sasha_pm: I'll message the customer with the plan: 1) temporary fallback applied, 2) patch + canary in ~2-3h, 3) rollback plan if regress. Will update them in 30m.

mike_eng: pushing hotfix branch now and requesting expedited review. If CR approved, will push hotfix to canary then prod.

carlos_eng: I can review in ~25m. I'll also run a seq_len counter validation script against recent logs.

alice_devex: adding PR to release checklist and pinging QA for smoke tests on canary.

sasha_pm: ownership recap: patch/PR -> @mike_eng, infra/routing -> @jenna_sre, oncall/monitoring -> @leo_oncall, customer comms -> @sasha_pm, CR/review -> @carlos_eng. ETA ~2.5h for full recovery. :thumbsup:

mike_eng: if we need immediate rollback of the kernel-selector change, revert commit abc123 (revert time ~15m).

jenna_sre: noted. preparing rollback steps and standby runbook.

sasha_pm: thanks everyone. I'll update this thread and the customer in 30m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
